definition: Current source navigation and eligible sections for Supplementary Table 1 (project TableS3) and Supplementary Tables 4–7. Existing S1/S2 correspond to submission Supplementary Tables 2/3 and remain outside this package. Supporting worksheets add no table numbers; finished workbooks/DOCX and editorial masters are not bundled.
Figures 2–8 follow PANEL_MAPPING.tsv. Figure 2: tissue programs; 3: G heterogeneity; 4: H layers; 5: RNA–protein associations; 6: gastric context; 7: cellular expression; 8: captured composition.

Original: 146 slots / 29 formal family instances (136 formal members plus 10 nonfamily slots). First supplement: 42 / 12. Second supplement: 10 / 2. Their inventory has 198 slots and 43 separate family instances; no pooled or study-wide FDR claim. Slots are not independent patients or evidence units. B technical scoring and A/C/K reporting add no inferential slots.
Native module tables are numerical authorities. The integrated table supplies identities and roles; its historical decimal projection does not replace native tokens.

Full-precision canonical scientific tokens are preserved after explicit public field reductions. Display effects and intervals: four decimal places; g_av: three; small nonzero quantities: scientific notation. P/q: four decimals or three significant digits in scientific notation below 0.001. Current saved display tokens are reused, not rounded again.
Patients for bulk, protein and bridge; donors for cellular expression and captured composition. Structural/eligible n in unavailable rows is not an analyzed sample count.
Adjacent non-tumor tissue is not healthy control tissue. All paired changes are tumor minus paired adjacent non-tumor.
Original prespecified analyses retain their registered roles. Every supplementary result is post_effect_exploratory; same-data diagnostics and same-patient layers are dependent.
Both remain co-primary. Diagnostic score/omission label changes do not replace the registered primary reproducibility state.

NA retains the source missing token. Non-estimable means the endpoint failed its registered eligibility/model rules; unavailable means the branch or quantity is not available; not applicable means no such test or quantity applies. Inactive backup slots were never analyzed.

Not available in the accepted extraction does not mean not reported by the source publication. Module A preserves all 405 availability/denominator rows; eligible details support 126 reconstructed rows. Detailed held-source labels/membership are excluded; aggregate known/unknown/unresolved counts remain complete. No imputation or new raw clinical acquisition.

Modern edgeR member models return native logFC, F, numerator/denominator degrees of freedom and P/q. Native coefficient CI/SE are unavailable; valid tests remain estimable. Full method-specific reasons are in accepted TSVs.

Rank scores summarize relative abundance position. Original protein ranks are relative TMT-ratio positions. Supplementary protein uses source median-centered log2 tumor/adjacent ratios; it supplies no two-tissue H4 score or g_av.

Primary program score: equal mean of (ascending average rank - 1)/(frozen background size - 1), retaining the approved member sets. Standardized-member means, common-background scores, alternative probe collapse, submodules and omissions retain their diagnostic roles.

Frozen RMA and one-to-one canonical mapping; primary multiple-probe collapse uses the within-sample median. The alternative uses the maximum pooled retained-sample mean expression, with frozen identifier tie-breaking. Detailed frozen choices remain in workflow/config/implementation/s02_processing_settings.yml.

Machine identifiers ending in _64 and _80 are historical population names. The accepted retained populations are read from their native biological_n fields. Reader labels say core and all-pair sensitivity; exact IDs remain in accepted TSVs and coverage mappings.

D7 slopes are per one unit of the fixed mean-of-gene-z-score proxy, not one composite SD. Rank H and standardized-member H have different units. Intercepts and R squared do not measure a proportion of average H decline explained or mediation.

Only existing q values under their original frozen families are carried over. Nominal diagnostics, descriptive values, unavailable and inactive slots do not create a new family. Diagnostic BH2 values in omission summaries remain diagnostic.
Four original methods retain their separate populations, scales and BH7 families. Captured proportions are not unbiased tissue proportions; repeated methods are dependent.

Canonical results/diagnostics tables retain the 113 first-supplement D7 omission fits and 1,276 original-bulk omission records, plus all second-supplement B/D/E influence and 10,000-draw outputs. Original full-cohort reference rows remain full-cohort estimates. Complete original bulk support: results/diagnostics/original/bulk/influence_diagnostics.tsv.

For the original inactive-backup slots only, legacy non-estimable CI tokens are displayed as No test (inactive backup), bound jointly to the original uncertainty token, endpoint state, no-activation reason and original role. Original tokens remain unchanged.

publication/table_marks.tsv maps each eligible display field to its canonical public path, 1-based data row and field. publication/RESULT_DISPOSITION.tsv covers all 198 slots. publication/TABLE_DIRECTORY.tsv preserves current section IDs and figure references. Internal binding containers and source line lookups are not public dependencies.
Tumor-site counts are decoded from the accepted tumor_site_codebook; the exact codes and original tokens remain in the accepted source copy.

publication/table_layout.json retains complete section identities, eligible display rows, current section notes and explicit held-row counts. Units, constant denominators, roles and uncertainty qualifications appear once in the section notes of the optional eligible workbook.
S6_29 contains signed tumor-minus-adjacent fraction differences, not fractions constrained to 0–1. Multiply a difference by 100 for percentage points; no conversion is performed in the workbook.

D: six separate component slopes, 80 GSE122401 and 33 TCGA-STAD patients, fixed BH6 with HC3 t intervals. E: four member associations in the common 80 patients, shared donor resampling and fixed BH4; 130 technical ratios are nested within patients.

B normalized H4 scoring remains a 23-pair technical sensitivity with no formal family, separate from rank H and historical raw-count-z. C reuses existing evidence with the 8 November singleton-label correction. K is HPA 25.1 IHC-only supporting context (41 records, four genes, eight antibodies, 16 source patient identifiers), without a main-figure assignment or inferential endpoints.
